newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium battens down hatches for major storm.
newsitem.headline: Belgium battens down hatches for major storm.

text.p: Belgium began to batten down the hatches on Monday in anticipation of major storms overnight and into Tuesday morning.

The meteriological office forecast wind speeds of up to 120 km an hour (75 miles per hour) and some private forecasters warned that they could reach 130 kph (81 mph) along the country's exposed North Sea coastline.
The Brussels environment ministry said all public parks and gardens around the capital would be closed for the duration of the storm.
It also advised people to avoid driving if possible in the forests to the south of the city -- a major artery for traffic arriving in and leaving the Belgian capital.
